result.stdout:
Usage: fs-hot-watch [global options] <command>

FsHotWatch — F# file watcher daemon
Global options:
  --verbose, -v                Verbose (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_VERBOSE)
  --log-level, -l <log-level>  Log level (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_LOG_LEVEL)
  --no-cache                   No cache (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_NO_CACHE)
  --no-warn-fail               No warn fail (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_NO_WARN_FAIL)
  --compact, -q                Compact (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_COMPACT)
  --agent, -a                  Agent (env: FS_HOT_WATCH_AGENT)

Commands:
  start            Start the daemon
  stop             Stop the daemon
  check            Run all checks
  build            Build the project
  test             Run tests
  format           Format code
  lint             Show lint results from daemon
  format-check     Show format-check results from daemon
  analyze          Show analyzer results from daemon
  status [plugin]  Show current status
  errors           Show accumulated errors
  scan             Scan for file changes
  rerun <plugin-name> Force a plugin to re-run, clearing its cached state
  init             Generate initial config
  config           Configuration commands
  coverage         Coverage commands
  completions      Install fish completions
